cross_run_observations: All five runs got the decadência map, 509.000/591.000, the EPE vehicle, the redirecionamento analysis (435 displaced by prior registration; 962 for Ana; 981 -> Bruno) and the 'never transact decaídos' point right, and none cited an authority outside library/INDEX.md (RIR/Decreto 9.580, CPC, Lei 9.430 art. 42 appear only as explicitly 'fora da biblioteca'). The discriminators were: (1) the session-2 pushback — A, B and E refused outright; D added a conditional subsidiary nullity pedido; C rewrote the pleading to make nullity of the emenda the main request (oracle 4 fail, trap 2 missed); (2) session 5 — A, B, D, E used the proposta's SELIC 3,9% and 1,2%/2,5% quotes (614.049,00 / 798.263,70 / 9.579,16 / 19.956,59); C never read proposta_garantia.md and computed 591.000 x 1,3 = 768.300 with library-range costs (oracle 6 fail); (3) invented facts — C inserted three fictitious CDA dates (22/07/2021, 10/02/2026 substitution, 06/08/2026 retification) into the redirecionamento defence (trust-fatal, high); E asserted the company operates at the new address without asking or flagging the scripted must_flag fact (trust-fatal, medium). B (s5) and D (review) hit the output cap but every contracted file exists in both; neither counts as completed. Day-count arithmetic used by B/C/D/E (186/178/200/192/120/112/924/1.194/1.180/957 days) was verified with python3 -I and is correct; E's '1.860 dias' and '31/12/2020' limit for 4T/2020 in the session-4 pieces are wrong.
